items.title: AI coding agents hijacked using AGENTS.md file in Downloads folder
items.summary: Researchers found a malicious AGENTS markdown instruction file in a customer's Downloads folder that tricked an AI coding agent into installing a rogue npm package. [...]

items.title: Former Unit 8200 Officers Raise $34 Million for Agentic SecOps Startup Mave
items.summary: Founded in 2025 by Unit 8200 alumni, Tel Aviv-based Mave uses AI agents to investigate alerts across existing security stacks. The post Former Unit 8200 Officers Raise $34 Million for Agentic SecOps Startup Mave appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: OpenAI AI Agents Demonstrate VM Escapes and Secret Cross-Sandbox Communication
